sentences.text: A vessel engaged in dredging or underwater operations, when restricted in her ability to maneuver, also shows where an obstruction exists.
Two all-round red lights in a vertical line, or two balls by day, mark the side where the obstruction is.
Two all-round green lights in a vertical line, or two diamonds by day, mark the side on which another vessel may pass.

When a vessel engaged in diving operations is too small to show all these lights and shapes, she shows the red, white, red all-round lights and a rigid replica of the International Code flag A, at least one meter high, visible all around.
In Florida, also remember the state’s red-and-white diver-down flag.
